review: 2:1 בְּרֶגַע תֵּחָטְפוּ — niphal of חטף, 'in a moment you shall be snatched away', for بِاخْتِطَافٍ تَرْتَقُونَ; the verb is biblical (Judg 21:21) and keeps the rapture image without a post-biblical noun.
2:3 הִנּוֹ בַּעֲנָנֵי כָבוֹד — 'behold Him in clouds of glory'; the Arabic is a plain 'He is', the הִנּוֹ is added for the line and for the second-coming force.
3:4 בְּמֶרְחֲבֵי מָרוֹם — 'in the broad places of the height', for فِي ذُرَى تِلْكَ الرُّبُوع; מֶרְחָב is the biblical word for wide open space (Ps 18:20).
4:2 מְלֵאִים בְּתִקְוָה חֲזָקָה — the Arabic is simply مَمْلُوئِين ('filled'); חֲזָקָה fills the line and matches the tune's caesura.
